text: Ironvale Athletic launches a counterattack from their own left side after Jonah Lindgren intercepts the ball deep near their defensive zone. The ball moves swiftly through midfield via Aiden Morales and then Teo Quinlan, who carries it forward on the right flank. Quinlan plays a precise through pass into space just outside the penalty area on the right, where Jonah Lindqvist advances and takes a shot from 9 metres out. The ball goes into the net at the Redmond Rovers’ goal, giving Ironvale Athletic a 1-0 lead early in the match[#40] [#45] [#50].
